---
name: Release
about: Prepare and verify a Markdown Comment Outline release
title: "[Release] v0.0.0"
labels: []
assignees: HyperNucleus
---

- [ ] Review changes and update version, README and changelog.
- [ ] Run npm ci, npm run test:unit, npm test and npm run package:vsix.
- [ ] Inspect and install the VSIX; verify navigation, tree, highlighting and settings.
- [ ] Verify the publisher ID and follow PUBLISHING.md when publication is authorized.
- [ ] Verify the published listing and tag the exact source commit.
